newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan seen posting 96/97 group net profit.
newsitem.headline: Nissan seen posting 96/97 group net profit.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd is expected to post a group net profit in the year to March 31, 1997, the first time in five years due to an improvement in its overseas business, a Japanese newspaper said on Tuesday.

The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said that it expects Nissan will post a group net profit of 40 to 50 billion yen in 1996/97, against an actual net loss of 88.4 billion yen the year before.
The paper said that Nissan's Mexican unit was expected to post a profit in 1996/97 and the profit of its U.S. unit was seen improving as well.
A Nissan spokesmen was not immediately available for comment on the report.
